subject: prd/prototype
statement: When Pyxis builds a prototype, Pyxis shall build it in a Git worktree of its own, on a branch that belongs to neither the feature's draft nor mainline.
rationale: "pyxis will go implement it in a work tree" (brainstorm:prototype#D-6)
fit_criterion: After a prototype run, every file the prototype changed is on the prototype's own branch, and the draft branch and mainline contain none of those changes
